meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把 web 应用部署到 Vercel，并在把网址给你之前，先跑本地构建、确认部署状态、检查线上能否正常访问；也能管理 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布 web 应用，或要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量等时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先本地构建，再部署并返回线上网址

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录
say.note: 运行 vercel ls 列出最近部署

say.text: 把 example.com 加到当前 Vercel 项目
say.note: 运行 vercel domains add 添加域名

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel. Before giving you a URL, it runs the local build, confirms the deployment is READY, and checks the live URL responds. It also manages Vercel projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, environment variables, and similar resources.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Builds locally, then deploys and returns the live URL
Runs vercel ls to show recent deployments

say_en.text: Add example.com to the current Vercel project
say_en.note: Runs vercel domains add to attach the domain
